title: From shared understanding to shared context
caption: AI can speed up some work, but what you hand an agent shapes its result. Context engineering offers a useful, imperfect analogy to requirements engineering; an AI interview can help clarify the handover.
description: How work can speed up without guaranteeing a better result, how static and dynamic context differ, how to spot context that goes bad, and how an AI interview can help build a useful handover to take into a fresh chat.
